new_page.title: Presale Projects Fraser Valley & Metro Vancouver 2027–2029 | Jared Gibbons
new_page.description: 134 presale condo and townhome projects completing 2027–2029 across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver, with developers, deposits and current published prices. Updated November 2026.
new_page.h1: Presale Projects in the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver, Completing 2027–2029

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built from Muse's presale list (2026-11-01). Prices appear only where the source dates them within three months. Paragon presale data is still to be merged, and projects sold through private channels may be missing.

This is my working list of publicly marketed presale projects in the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver that are scheduled to complete between 2027 and 2029. It starts with the Fraser Valley, where I work, and then covers Metro Vancouver. Each table shows the developer, home type, size, estimated completion year, a published price where one is current, and the deposit as published.

The list holds 134 projects: 78 completing in 2027, 48 completing in 2028, 8 completing in 2029. 51 fall in the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board area and 83 in the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® area. Of the 134, 15 have a price published within the last three months and 70 have a deposit structure published.
By city: Surrey 25, Langley 15, Abbotsford 8, Delta 3, Maple Ridge 3, Burnaby 21, Coquitlam 21, Vancouver 22, Richmond 3, North Vancouver 4, Squamish 3, and the rest in smaller numbers.

blocks.text: How presales work in BC: tax, deposits and the 7-day rescission period
Ask Jared about a presale project

faq.q: Is this every presale project in the region?
faq.a: No. It covers projects marketed publicly through presale listings and developers' own pages as of November 2026. Projects sold only through private or brokerage-exclusive channels may be missing, and Paragon presale data is still to be added.

faq.q: Why do some projects say to ask for current pricing?
faq.a: A price is shown only when its source dates it within the last three months. Presale prices change often, and an older price can mislead, so I give the current list on request.

faq.q: Where do the completion dates come from?
faq.a: From the developers' own pages and public presale listings. Completion estimates move, so treat them as targets and confirm with the developer.
